info.name: Exactly Protocol Auditor ERC-4626 Rewards Query API

items.docs: Returns an array of all ERC-20 reward tokens registered in the RewardsController.

info.name: Get all market operations eligible for rewards

items.docs: Returns all market-operation pairs (deposit/borrow) registered for reward distribution.

info.name: Get total claimable reward amount for an account

items.docs: Returns the total amount of a specific reward token claimable by an account across all markets and operations.

info.name: Get claimable rewards for specific market operations

items.docs: Returns the claimable amount of a specific reward token for an account across a specified list of market operations.

info.name: Preview reward allocation for a time period

items.docs: Returns projected deposit and borrow reward allocations and utilization for a specified time delta, useful for estimating rewards APR.
